# Nehemiah Chapter 9 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 472r–472v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/NEH_009_page_001.jpg

---

**9:1** And-on-the-twenty-fourth day of-this month the-sons of-Yisra'el gathered [ne'esfu] with-fasting [be-tsom] and-in-sackcloth [u-ve-saqqim] and-earth [va-adamah] upon-them.

**9:2** And-the-seed [zera] of-Yisra'el separated-themselves [va-yibbadlu] from all the-sons of-foreigners [benei nekhar], and-they-stood [va-ya'amdu] and-confessed [va-yitvaddu] their-sins [chatoteyhem] and-the-iniquities [va-avonot] of-their-fathers [avoteyhem].

**9:3** And-they-stood-up on-their-place [al omdam] and-read [va-yiqre'u] in-the-book of-the-Torah of-YHWH their-God a-fourth of-the-day [revi'it ha-yom], and-a-fourth they-were-confessing [mitvaddim] and-worshiping [u-mishtachavim] to-YHWH their-God.

**9:4** And-there-stood-up on-the-stairs [ma'aleh] of-the-Levi'im: Yeshua and-Bani, Qadmi'el, Shevanyah, Bunni, Sherevyah, Bani, Kenani. And-they-cried-out [va-yiz'aqu] with-a-great voice [be-qol gadol] to YHWH their-God.

**9:5** And-the-Levi'im said — Yeshua and-Qadmi'el, Bani, Chashavneyah, Sherevyah, Hodiyyah, Shevanyah, Petachyah — "Stand-up [qumu]! Bless [barekhu] YHWH your-God from-everlasting to-everlasting [min ha-olam ad ha-olam]! And-let-them-bless the-name [shem] of-your-glory [kevodeikha] that-is-exalted [meromam] above all blessing [berakhah] and-praise [u-tehillah]."

**9:6** "You [are] he, YHWH, you alone [levaddekha]. You made [asita] the-heavens [ha-shamayim], the-heavens of-the-heavens [shemey ha-shamayim] and-all their-host [tseva'am], the-earth and-all that-is upon-it, the-seas and-all that-is in-them, and-you give-life [mechayyeh] to-all of-them, and-the-host [tseva] of-the-heavens to-you bow-down [mishtachavim].

**9:7** You [are] he, YHWH the-God, who chose [bacharta] Avram and-brought-him-out [hotseto] from-Ur of-the-Kasdim and-set [samta] his-name Avraham.

**9:8** And-you-found [u-matsata] his-heart [levavo] faithful [ne'eman] before-you [lefanekha], and-you-cut [ve-kharot] with-him the-covenant [ha-berit] to-give the-land [erets] of-the-Kena'ani, the-Chitti, the-Emori, the-Perizzi, the-Yevusi, and-the-Girgashi, to-give [latet] to-his-seed [le-zar'o]. And-you-established [va-taqem] your-words [devarekha], for righteous [tsaddiq] [are] you.

**9:9** And-you-saw [va-tere] the-affliction [oni] of-our-fathers in-Mitsrayim and-their-cry [za'aqatam] you-heard at the-Sea of-Reeds [Yam Suf].

**9:10** And-you-gave [va-titten] signs [otot] and-wonders [u-mofetim] against-Par'oh and-against-all his-servants and-against-all the-people of-his-land, for you-knew [yadta] that they-acted-arrogantly [hezidu] against-them. And-you-made for-yourself a-name [shem] as-this-day [ke-ha-yom ha-zeh].

**9:11** And-the-sea you-split [baqa'ta] before-them and-they-passed-through in-the-midst of-the-sea on-dry-ground [ba-yabashah], and-their-pursuers [ve-et rodepheyhem] you-cast [hishlakhta] into-the-depths [bi-metsolot], like-a-stone [ke-even] into-mighty waters [be-mayim azzim].

**9:12** And-by-a-pillar of-cloud [ammud anan] you-led-them [hinchitam] by-day, and-by-a-pillar of-fire [ammud esh] by-night, to-light [le-ha'ir] for-them the-way [ha-derekh] in-which they-should-go [yelkhu].

**9:13** And-upon Mount Sinay [Har Sinay] you-came-down [yaradta] and-spoke [ve-dabber] with-them from-heaven [mi-shamayim], and-you-gave-them just [yesharim] judgments [mishpatim] and-true [emet] laws [torot], good [tovim] statutes [chuqqim] and-commandments [u-mitsvot].

**9:14** And-your-holy Sabbath [Shabbat qodshekha] you-made-known to-them [hoda'ta lahem], and-commandments and-statutes and-Torah you-commanded them by-the-hand of-Mosheh your-servant.

**9:15** And-bread [lechem] from-heaven you-gave-them for-their-hunger [le-ra'avam], and-water from-a-rock [mi-sela] you-brought-out [hotseta] for-them for-their-thirst [le-tsma'am]. And-you-told-them to-go-in [lavo] to-possess [lareshet] the-land which you-had-lifted [nasata] your-hand [yadekha] to-give them.

**9:16** But-they and-our-fathers acted-arrogantly [hezidu] and-stiffened [va-yaqshu] their-neck [orpham] and-did-not listen [lo sham'u] to-your-commandments.

**9:17** And-they-refused [va-yema'anu] to-listen and-did-not remember [lo zakheru] your-wonders [nifle'otekha] which you-did among-them, and-they-stiffened their-neck and-appointed [va-yittenu] a-head [rosh] to-return [lashuv] to-their-bondage [le-avdutam] in-their-rebellion [be-miriyam]. But-you [are] a-God of-forgiveness [Eloha selichot], gracious [channun] and-compassionate [ve-rachum], slow [erekh] of-anger [appayim] and-great [ve-rav] of-covenant-faithfulness [chesed], and-you-did-not abandon-them [lo azavtam].

**9:18** Even [af] when they-made for-themselves a-cast [massekah] calf [egel] and-said, 'This [is] your-god [elohekha] who-brought-you-up from-Mitsrayim,' and-they-did great blasphemies [ne'atsot gedolot] —

**9:19** you in-your-great mercies [rachamekha ha-rabbim] did-not abandon-them in-the-wilderness [ba-midbar]. The-pillar of-cloud did-not depart [lo sar] from-upon them by-day to-lead-them [le-hanchotam] on-the-way, nor-the-pillar of-fire by-night to-light for-them the-way in-which they-should-go.

**9:20** And-your-good Spirit [Ruchakha ha-tovah] you-gave to-instruct-them [le-haskilam], and-your-manna [mannekha] you-did-not withhold [lo mana'ta] from-their-mouth, and-water you-gave-them for-their-thirst.

**9:21** And-forty years [arba'im shanah] you-sustained-them [kiltam] in-the-wilderness; they-lacked [chaseru] nothing [lo]. Their-garments [salmoteyhem] did-not wear-out [lo valu] and-their-feet [ve-ragleihem] did-not swell [lo vatsequ].

**9:22** And-you-gave-them kingdoms [mamlekhot] and-peoples [ve-ammim] and-divided-them [va-tachalqem] corner-by-corner [le-fe'ah]. And-they-possessed the-land of-Sichon and-the-land of-the-king of-Cheshbon and-the-land of-Og king of-ha-Bashan.

**9:23** And-their-sons [u-veneyhem] you-multiplied [hirbita] like-the-stars [ke-kokhevei] of-the-heavens, and-you-brought-them to the-land which you-told their-fathers to-enter to-possess.

**9:24** And-the-sons came-in [va-yavo'u] and-possessed the-land, and-you-subdued [va-takhna] before-them the-inhabitants [yoshevei] of-the-land, the-Kena'anim, and-you-gave-them into-their-hand, and-their-kings and-the-peoples of-the-land, to-do with-them according-to-their-will [ki-retsonam].

**9:25** And-they-captured [va-yilkedu] fortified [betsurot] cities and-fat [shemenah] land, and-possessed houses full [male'im] of-all good [kol tuv], hewn-cisterns [borot chatsuvim], vineyards and-olive-groves and-fruit-trees [ets ma'akhal] in-abundance [la-rov]. And-they-ate and-were-satisfied [va-yisba'u] and-grew-fat [va-yashminu] and-delighted-themselves [va-yit'addenu] in-your-great goodness [be-tuvkha ha-gadol].

**9:26** But-they-were-disobedient [va-yamru] and-rebelled [va-yimredu] against-you and-cast [va-yashlikhu] your-Torah behind their-back [acharey gabbam], and-your-prophets [nevi'ekha] they-killed [hargu] who-warned-them [he'idu vam] to-turn-them-back [la-hashivam] to-you, and-they-did great blasphemies.

**9:27** And-you-gave-them into-the-hand of-their-adversaries [tsareyhem] and-they-oppressed-them [va-yatsiru lahem]. And-in-the-time of-their-distress [be-et tsaratam] they-cried-out [yits'aqu] to-you, and-you from-the-heavens heard, and-according-to-your-great mercies [rachamekha ha-rabbim] you-gave-them saviors [moshi'im] who-saved-them from-the-hand of-their-adversaries.

**9:28** But-when-they-had-rest [u-khe-nuach lahem] they-returned [yashuvu] to-do evil [la'asot ra] before-you, and-you-abandoned-them in-the-hand of-their-enemies [oyeveyhem] and-they-ruled-over-them [va-yirdu vahem]. And-they-returned and-cried-out to-you, and-you from-the-heavens heard and-delivered-them [tatssilem] according-to-your-mercies many-times [rabbat ittim].

**9:29** And-you-warned-them [va-ta'ed bahem] to-return-them to-your-Torah, but-they-acted-arrogantly and-did-not listen to-your-commandments, and-against-your-judgments they-sinned — which a-man shall-do [ya'aseh] them and-live [va-chay] by-them — and-they-gave a-stubborn shoulder [katef soreretah] and-stiffened their-neck and-did-not listen.

**9:30** And-you-extended [va-timshokh] over-them many years [shanim rabbot] and-warned-them by-your-Spirit [be-Ruchakha] by-the-hand of-your-prophets, and-they-did-not give-ear [lo he'ezinu]. And-you-gave-them into-the-hand of-the-peoples of-the-lands [ammey ha-aratsot].

**9:31** But-in-your-great mercies you-did-not make-an-end [lo asitam kalah] of-them and-did-not abandon-them, for a-gracious [channun] and-compassionate [ve-rachum] God [El] [are] you.

**9:32** And-now, our-God, the-God the-great, the-mighty [ha-gibbor] and-the-fearsome [ve-ha-nora], who-keeps the-covenant and-the-covenant-faithfulness [ha-chesed], let-not-seem-small [al yim'at] before-you all the-hardship [ha-tela'ah] that-has-found-us [metsa'atnu], our-kings, our-princes [sarenu], our-priests, our-prophets, our-fathers, and-all your-people, from-the-days of-the-kings of-Ashur until this day.

**9:33** And-you [are] righteous [tsaddiq] in-all that-has-come upon-us, for truth [emet] you-have-done and-we have-acted-wickedly [hirsha'nu].

**9:34** And-our-kings, our-princes, our-priests, and-our-fathers have-not done [lo asu] your-Torah and-have-not listened to-your-commandments and-to-your-warnings [edvotekha] which you-warned-them.

**9:35** And-they in-their-kingdom [be-malkhutam] and-in-your-great goodness [tuvkha ha-rav] which you-gave-them and-in-the-broad [ha-rechavah] and-fat [ha-shemenah] land which you-set before-them — they-did-not serve-you [lo avadukha] and-did-not turn [lo shabu] from-their-evil deeds [ma'aleyhem ha-ra'im].

**9:36** Behold [hinneh], we [are] today servants [avadim], and-the-land which you-gave to-our-fathers to-eat its-fruit and-its-good — behold, we [are] servants upon-it.

**9:37** And-its-great produce [tevuatah rabah] is-for the-kings [la-melakhim] whom you-set over-us because-of our-sins, and-over our-bodies [geviyyotenu] they-are-ruling [moshelim] and-over our-livestock [behemtenu] according-to-their-will [ki-retsonam], and-we [are] in-great distress [be-tsarah gedolah].

**9:38** And-in-all this [u-ve-khol zot] we are-making [koretim] a-firm-covenant [amanah], and-writing [ve-khotvim], and-upon the-sealed [ha-chatum] [document are] our-princes, our-Levi'im, our-priests.

---

## EMET's Textual Notes
1. **9:6 "heavens of the heavens"** — The superlative construction *shemey ha-shamayim* expresses the totality of the cosmos above, encompassing all celestial spheres.
2. **9:17 "God of forgiveness"** — Hebrew *Eloha selichot*; the plural *selichot* intensifies the concept — God whose very nature is defined by forgiveness. This phrase appears only here in the Hebrew Bible.
3. **9:20 "your good Spirit"** — A rare reference to the divine Spirit (*Ruach*) as instructor, paralleling Isaiah 63:10-11. The adjective *tovah* (good) characterizes the Spirit's nature.
4. **9:29 "which a man shall do and live by them"** — A quotation of Leviticus 18:5, embedding Torah obedience within the framework of life itself.

*— EMET*
